parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device that you want to query.

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of a device, which corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records to display on each page in the response. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: ShareTaskCode
parameters.description:
The share code of the speech corpus sharing task.

You can obtain the **share code** on the **Shared Corpus Management** page of the **Thousand Miles Voice Broadcast Service**.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the speech corpus to query. Valid values:

- **1**: Pending review.
- **2**: Approved.
- **3**: Rejected.
